title: Order parts controls the work order Parts tab (on shows it, off hides it)
custom_preconds:
1. You can configure a custom role.
  2. A work order with at least one part line exists.
custom_steps:
1. In a custom role, turn Order parts ON (with See Financial Data ON, which it needs) and save.
  2. Log in as a user with that role and open a work order.
  3. Look for the Parts tab.
  4. Now turn Order parts OFF in the role and save.
  5. Log back in as that user and open a work order.
  6. Look for the Parts tab.
custom_expected:
With Order parts on, the work order Parts tab is shown and can be opened.

With Order parts off, the Parts tab is hidden.

The Parts tab visibility is controlled by Order parts.
evidence: UI: Order parts controls the WO Parts tab — role WITH woOrderParts shows tabs Lines/Parts(7)/Notes/Stats (Parts tab present); the Technician role (woPickParts, no woOrderParts) showed Lines/Notes/Stats with NO Parts tab. On shows it, off hides it.
